atlas: AXOM Comprehensive Atlas of Human Disease & Pathology V2

diseases.name: Primary open-angle glaucoma
diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Progressive retinal ganglion-cell damage with open drainage angle; pressure is a risk factor but not a required diagnostic threshold.

diseases.name: Primary angle-closure glaucoma and acute angle-closure crisis
diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Iridotrabecular contact blocks outflow; a painful acute intraocular-pressure spike requires emergent treatment.

diseases.name: Age-related macular degeneration
diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Drusen and retinal-pigment-epithelium dysfunction cause central visual loss; late atrophy and neovascularization are distinct.

diseases.name: Diabetic retinopathy
diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Hyperglycemic retinal microangiopathy; macular edema may occur across stages while neovascularization defines proliferative disease.

diseases.name: Rhegmatogenous retinal detachment
diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Full-thickness retinal break admits vitreous fluid beneath retina; flashes, floaters and peripheral curtain are urgent signs.

diseases.name: Central retinal vein occlusion
diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Retinal venous obstruction produces widespread hemorrhages and macular edema; ischemia raises neovascular-glaucoma risk.

diseases.name: Central retinal artery occlusion
diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Sudden profound painless monocular vision loss is a retinal ischemic stroke demanding immediate stroke-center assessment.

diseases.name: Bacterial keratitis with corneal ulceration
diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Corneal epithelial defect plus stromal infiltrate may progress to melting and perforation; collect cultures in severe/atypical disease.

diseases.name: Noninfectious anterior uveitis
diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Pain and photophobia with anterior chamber cells and flare; infectious mimics require exclusion before steroids.

diseases.name: Retinoblastoma
diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Childhood malignant retinal tumor with biallelic RB1 inactivation; leukocoria warrants urgent specialist evaluation.

diseases.name: Uveal melanoma
diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Adult uveal melanocytic malignancy often involving GNAQ/GNA11 signaling; hepatic metastasis is a major risk.

diseases.name: Age-related cataract
diseases.diagnostic_discriminator: Oxidative modification and aggregation of lens crystallins reduce transparency; function-limiting disease treated by extraction.
